verdict.rationale: Box provides building blocks for background automation—webhooks and event feeds that fire on content changes (box-docs-7, box-docs-19, box-docs-22), an AI Extract feature that automatically pulls metadata when files land in a folder (box-docs-12), and an MCP server letting AI agents act on Box content (box-docs-11, box-docs-29). However, these require developers to wire together webhooks/events with custom logic; there's no documented no-code 'automation builder' or persistent autonomous agent runtime that a non-developer AI-native user could simply configure. Missing for 10: a first-class autonomous automation/workflow product (e.g., Relay-style rules engine) documented with agent-triggered actions, and independent evidence of it running unattended in production.
